title: Capard Glenbarrow Ecoloop Walking Route

images.title: kevin higgins / River Barrow Waterfall
images.caption: River Barrow Waterfall. The flora of the Capard Glenbarrow Ecoloop is characteristic of the Slieve Bloom Mountains, with heather and gorse covering the uplands, creating a striking landscape in late summer when the flowers bloom in vibrant purple and yellow hues. Wooded sections of the trail feature a mix of birch, oak, and Scots pine, providing shelter for various ferns and mosses. In the wetter areas, you might spot sphagnum moss and other bog-loving plants, such as cotton grass. The fauna in the area includes birds like meadow pipits, kestrels, and skylarks, which are common in the open moorland, while the woodlands are home to robins, chaffinches, and wrens. Red squirrels, foxes, and pine martens also inhabit the area, though they can be elusive. The streams and boggy patches support amphibians like frogs and newts, adding to the biodiversity of the region.

images.caption: Capard Cairns on the Ridge of Capard. Beyond the natural beauty, the trail is steeped in history and folklore. The Slieve Bloom Mountains have long been a place of significance, with ancient legends and stories associated with the area. Walking through this unspoiled environment offers a chance to connect with the rich natural heritage and cultural history of the region.

description: This circular loop walk takes you along the waymarked Capard Glenbarrow Ecoloop near Rosenallis in the Slieve Bloom Mountains. Along the way, you will encounter the beautiful Glenbarrow waterfall, which is a highlight of the route, especially after periods of rainfall when the falls are at their most dramatic. The trail also offers panoramic views across the surrounding mountains and valleys, with several viewpoints along the way to stop and take in the scenery. The paths are a mix of boardwalks, gravel, and natural terrain, ensuring the area is preserved while allowing easy navigation. The Glenbarrow Waterfall Loop runs alongside the Ecoloop so it's easy to continue your walking in the area on this popular walk.
